name: Cature Hafuringu
original_name: カチュア・ハーフリング
source:
She is very close to her older sister [url=/c23638]Rachel[/url] who she views as her wizarding rival.

A devilish personality, she tries her best in pushing past her limits but comes off as childish. Overconfident, Cature believes to be the better of the two sisters, viewing herself as history's greatest wizard.

Due to her personality, she pokes fun at [url=/c42047]Tomohiro[/url] who has nothing to offer except his semen at every given moment.

Having devoted herself to the study of magic for all her life, Cature is extremely unfamiliar with matters outside of magic having little understanding on things like common sense and human subtleties.

She loves sweets.

[Translated from [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/3ping/char.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
